content: आसारः [आ-सृ-घञ्] .²1 A hard or sharp-driving shower (of anything); आसारसिक्तक्षितिबाष्पयोगात् <ls>R. 13. 29</ls>; <ls>Me. 17</ls>; पुष्पासारैः <ls n="Me.">43</ls>; so तुहिन˚, रुधिर˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; बाष्पासारा <ls>M. 3. 20</ls> flooded or suffused with tears; धारासारैर्वृष्टिर्बभूव <ls>H. 3</ls> it rained in torrents. .²2 Surrounding an enemy. .²3 Attack, incursion. .²4 The army of an ally or king (whose dominions are separated by other intervening states); पार्ष्णिग्राहासरौ अन्तःकोपम् आटविकं वा समुत्थापयितुकामः <ls>Kau. A. 1. 16</ls>. .²5 Provision, food; अज्ञानविविधासारतोयशस्यो व्रजेत्तु यः <ls>Pt. 3. 41</ls>, <ls n="Pt. 3.">51</ls>.
